canonical_project: Digital FSM - Secure Government Network and Data Center / Government Cloud (FSM-Cloud)
owner: Government of the Federated States of Micronesia (DTCI/Digital FSM Office); World Bank/IDA funding (P170718, US$30.8M)
notes: Digital FSM (World Bank P170718) includes Secure Government Network and Data Center, Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity and Government Cloud (FSM-Cloud) components per ESMP and project documents; World Bank results story (2026-07-07) tracks new digital services hosted on private-sector-operated green data centers with a target of 3 by March 2027. Project lead until procurement/commissioning names a site and operator; likely Palikir/Kolonia (Pohnpei) but not confirmed.
